dish: copper-griddled hot cake (cut in six) and house pudding
n: Junkissa American (純喫茶アメリカン)
w: Dōtonbori jun-kissa founded 1946, rebuilt 1963 with chandeliers and a spiral staircase; Time Out calls it one of Osaka's most iconic kissaten and Osaka Metro's OsakaMania and Kansai Walker feature its copper-plate hot cake.

dish: Ōgonkai Ramen (golden freshwater-clam & chicken broth, light shoyu)
n: Naniwa Menjiro (なにわ 麺次郎)
address: 4-1-17 Namba, Chūō-ku, Osaka 542-0076 (inside Kintetsu Osaka-Namba Station — platform ticket needed)
w: Michelin Guide-listed ramen counter inside Kintetsu Osaka-Namba Station and a Tabelog Ramen OSAKA Hyakumeiten 2025 pick; the clam-dashi Ōgonkai ramen is the signature, with Oigatsuo ramen as runner-up.
